what: Labels and the fixed protocol for evaluating objects.py (identification by the world model's own words, and tracking through time) on the two sample phone clips. Written before the run.
labelled_by: Claude, reading 2 fps frames (t = i and i + 0.5 s) of the original files, 2026-09-26; step i covers [i, i+1) s of its footage. 1 = in view in either frame, 0 = not, null = cannot tell (not scored).

keys_location.note: where the keys are during each step: floor / hand / table / chair; null = out of view

place_lexicon.note: the first of a sighting's place words (the model's own top words there) found here names its location; none found = unknown

negatives.wiring-cam-20260926T182226809: lastseen_smoke, 12 steps of a synthetic test pattern (no objects): every label 0
negatives.robot: lastseen_smoke home, 130 steps of two AgiBot head-camera clips; the video lives outside this tree, so these are unlabelled distractors: hits there are counted, not scored

metrics: per object name, the steps ranked by the name score: P@1 and P@support over the labelled steps; the tracker's own decision (score above corpus.split's cut): step precision and recall; absent names: how many produce any sighting. Through time: the keys' last-known location after each clip lands (serve's granularity) and after every step (a stricter replay), against the location of the last step the keys were in view.
